Gangster Anmol Bishnoi Seeks Surrender in Salman Khan Firing Case

Wanted gangster Anmol Bishnoi has reportedly expressed a desire to surrender in connection with the firing incident outside actor Salman Khan's residence. Bishnoi has appealed to the court, stating he wishes to surrender in the interest of justice. This development comes as part of the ongoing investigation into the case.
